- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.

88	func TestPostSignsRequest(t *testing.T) {
89		// httptest listens on 127.0.0.1, which the SSRF guard blocks by default.
90		prev := AllowPrivateIPs
91		AllowPrivateIPs = true
92		defer func() { AllowPrivateIPs = prev }()
93	
94		rawKey := []byte("0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef")
95		cases := []struct {
96			name   string
97			secret string
98			key    []byte
99		}{
100			{name: "plain secret", secret: "plain-secret-value", key: []byte("plain-secret-value")},
101			{name: "whsec_ secret", secret: "whsec_" + base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(rawKey), key: rawKey},
102		}
103	
104		for _, tc := range cases {
105			t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
106				var gotID, gotTimestamp, gotSignature string
107				var gotBody []byte
108				server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
109					gotID = r.Header.Get("webhook-id")
110					gotTimestamp = r.Header.Get("webhook-timestamp")
111					gotSignature = r.Header.Get("webhook-signature")
112					gotBody, _ = io.ReadAll(r.Body)
113					_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{"code":0}`))
114				}))
115				defer server.Close()
116	
117				err := Post(&WebhookRequestPayload{
118					URL:           server.URL,
119					ActivityType:  "memos.memo.created",
120					Creator:       "users/1",
121					SigningSecret: tc.secret,
122				})
123				require.NoError(t, err)
124	
125				require.True(t, strings.HasPrefix(gotID, "msg_"), "webhook-id should be prefixed with msg_")
126				require.NotEmpty(t, gotTimestamp)
127				require.True(t, strings.HasPrefix(gotSignature, "v1,"), "signature should carry the v1 version tag")
128	
129				// Recompute the signature the way a receiver would and confirm it matches.
130				mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, tc.key)
131				mac.Write([]byte(gotID + "." + gotTimestamp + "."))
132				mac.Write(gotBody)
133				want := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
134				require.Equal(t, "v1,"+want, gotSignature)
135			})
136		}
137	}

53	func (s *APIV1Service) CreateUserWebhook(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.CreateUserWebhookRequest) (*v1pb.UserWebhook, error) {
54		user, err := s.resolveUserFromName(ctx, request.Parent)
55		if err != nil {
56			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid parent: %v", err)
57		}
58		userID := user.ID
59	
60		currentUser, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
61		if err != nil {
62			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get current user: %v", err)
63		}
64		if currentUser == nil {
65			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
66		}
67		if currentUser.ID != userID && currentUser.Role != store.RoleAdmin {
68			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
69		}
70	
71		if request.Webhook.Url == "" {
72			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "webhook URL is required")
73		}
74		if err := webhook.ValidateURL(strings.TrimSpace(request.Webhook.Url)); err != nil {
75			return nil, err
76		}
77		// The signing secret is generated server-side so it always meets the Standard
78		// Webhooks length requirement. A client-supplied secret is still accepted (and
79		// validated) for backward compatibility.
80		signingSecret := strings.TrimSpace(request.Webhook.SigningSecret)
81		if signingSecret == "" {
82			signingSecret, err = webhook.GenerateSigningSecret()
83			if err != nil {
84				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to generate signing secret: %v", err)
85			}
86		} else if err := webhook.ValidateSigningSecret(signingSecret); err != nil {
87			return nil, err
88		}
89	
90		webhookID := generateUserWebhookID()
91		webhook := &storepb.WebhooksUserSetting_Webhook{
92			Id:            webhookID,
93			Title:         request.Webhook.DisplayName,
94			Url:           strings.TrimSpace(request.Webhook.Url),
95			SigningSecret: signingSecret,
96		}
97	
98		err = s.Store.AddUserWebhook(ctx, userID, webhook)
99		if err != nil {
100			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create webhook: %v", err)
101		}
102	
103		return convertUserWebhookFromUserSetting(webhook, user), nil
104	}

106	func (s *APIV1Service) UpdateUserWebhook(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.UpdateUserWebhookRequest) (*v1pb.UserWebhook, error) {
107		if request.Webhook == nil {
108			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "webhook is required")
109		}
110	
111		user, webhookID, err := s.resolveUserAndWebhookIDFromName(ctx, request.Webhook.Name)
112		if err != nil {
113			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid webhook name: %v", err)
114		}
115		userID := user.ID
116	
117		currentUser, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
118		if err != nil {
119			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get current user: %v", err)
120		}
121		if currentUser == nil {
122			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
123		}
124		if currentUser.ID != userID && currentUser.Role != store.RoleAdmin {
125			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
126		}
127	
128		// Get existing webhooks
129		webhooks, err := s.Store.GetUserWebhooks(ctx, userID)
130		if err != nil {
131			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user webhooks: %v", err)
132		}
133	
134		// Find the webhook to update
135		var targetWebhook *storepb.WebhooksUserSetting_Webhook
136		for _, webhook := range webhooks {
137			if webhook.Id == webhookID {
138				targetWebhook = webhook
139				break
140			}
141		}
142	
143		if targetWebhook == nil {
144			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "webhook not found")
145		}
146	
147		// Update the webhook
148		updatedWebhook := &storepb.WebhooksUserSetting_Webhook{
149			Id:            webhookID,
150			Title:         targetWebhook.Title,
151			Url:           targetWebhook.Url,
152			SigningSecret: targetWebhook.SigningSecret,
153		}
154	
155		if request.UpdateMask != nil {
156			for _, path := range request.UpdateMask.Paths {
157				switch path {
158				case "url":
159					if request.Webhook.Url != "" {
160						trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(request.Webhook.Url)
161						if err := webhook.ValidateURL(trimmed); err != nil {
162							return nil, err
163						}
164						updatedWebhook.Url = trimmed
165					}
166				case "display_name":
167					updatedWebhook.Title = request.Webhook.DisplayName
168				case "signing_secret":
169					secret := strings.TrimSpace(request.Webhook.SigningSecret)
170					if err := webhook.ValidateSigningSecret(secret); err != nil {
171						return nil, err
172					}
173					updatedWebhook.SigningSecret = secret
174				default:
175					// Ignore unsupported fields
176				}
177			}
178		} else {
179			// If no update mask is provided, update all fields
180			if request.Webhook.Url != "" {
181				trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(request.Webhook.Url)
182				if err := webhook.ValidateURL(trimmed); err != nil {
183					return nil, err
184				}
185				updatedWebhook.Url = trimmed
186			}
187			updatedWebhook.Title = request.Webhook.DisplayName
188			if request.Webhook.SigningSecret != "" {
189				secret := strings.TrimSpace(request.Webhook.SigningSecret)
190				if err := webhook.ValidateSigningSecret(secret); err != nil {
191					return nil, err
192				}
193				updatedWebhook.SigningSecret = secret
194			}
195		}
196	
197		err = s.Store.UpdateUserWebhook(ctx, userID, updatedWebhook)
198		if err != nil {
199			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to update webhook: %v", err)
200		}
201	
202		return convertUserWebhookFromUserSetting(updatedWebhook, user), nil
203	}

11	// reservedCIDRs lists IP ranges that must never be targeted by outbound webhook requests.
12	// Covers loopback, RFC-1918 private, link-local (including cloud IMDS at 169.254.169.254),
13	// and their IPv6 equivalents.
14	var reservedCIDRs = []string{
15		"127.0.0.0/8",    // IPv4 loopback
16		"10.0.0.0/8",     // RFC-1918 class A
17		"172.16.0.0/12",  // RFC-1918 class B
18		"192.168.0.0/16", // RFC-1918 class C
19		"169.254.0.0/16", // Link-local / cloud IMDS
20		"::1/128",        // IPv6 loopback
21		"fc00::/7",       // IPv6 unique local
22		"fe80::/10",      // IPv6 link-local
23	}

25	// reservedNetworks is the parsed form of reservedCIDRs, built once at startup.
26	var reservedNetworks []*net.IPNet
27	
28	func init() {
29		for _, cidr := range reservedCIDRs {
30			_, network, err := net.ParseCIDR(cidr)
31			if err != nil {
32				panic("webhook: invalid reserved CIDR " + cidr + ": " + err.Error())
33			}
34			reservedNetworks = append(reservedNetworks, network)
35		}
36	}

38	// AllowPrivateIPs controls whether webhook URLs may resolve to reserved/private
39	// IP addresses. When true, the SSRF protection is disabled. This is useful for
40	// self-hosted deployments where webhooks target services on the local network.
41	var AllowPrivateIPs bool

43	// isReservedIP reports whether ip falls within any reserved/private range.
44	func isReservedIP(ip net.IP) bool {
45		if AllowPrivateIPs {
46			return false
47		}
48		for _, network := range reservedNetworks {
49			if network.Contains(ip) {
50				return true
51			}
52		}
53		return false
54	}

56	// ValidateURL checks that rawURL:
57	//  1. Parses as a valid absolute URL.
58	//  2. Uses the http or https scheme.
59	//  3. Does not resolve to a reserved/private IP address.
60	//
61	// It returns a gRPC InvalidArgument status error so callers can return it directly.
62	func ValidateURL(rawURL string) error {
63		u, err := url.ParseRequestURI(rawURL)
64		if err != nil {
65			return status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid webhook URL: %v", err)
66		}
67		if u.Scheme != "http" && u.Scheme != "https" {
68			return status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "webhook URL must use http or https scheme, got %q", u.Scheme)
69		}

71		ips, err := net.LookupHost(u.Hostname())
72		if err != nil {
73			return status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "webhook URL hostname could not be resolved: %v", err)
74		}

76		for _, ipStr := range ips {

86	// TestPostSignsRequest verifies the end-to-end Standard Webhooks signature so a
87	// receiver following the documented verification recipe will accept our requests.
88	func TestPostSignsRequest(t *testing.T) {
89		// httptest listens on 127.0.0.1, which the SSRF guard blocks by default.
90		prev := AllowPrivateIPs
91		AllowPrivateIPs = true
92		defer func() { AllowPrivateIPs = prev }()
93	
94		rawKey := []byte("0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef")
95		cases := []struct {
96			name   string
97			secret string
98			key    []byte
99		}{
100			{name: "plain secret", secret: "plain-secret-value", key: []byte("plain-secret-value")},
101			{name: "whsec_ secret", secret: "whsec_" + base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(rawKey), key: rawKey},
102		}
103	
104		for _, tc := range cases {
105			t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
106				var gotID, gotTimestamp, gotSignature string
107				var gotBody []byte
108				server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
109					gotID = r.Header.Get("webhook-id")
110					gotTimestamp = r.Header.Get("webhook-timestamp")
111					gotSignature = r.Header.Get("webhook-signature")
112					gotBody, _ = io.ReadAll(r.Body)
113					_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{"code":0}`))
114				}))
115				defer server.Close()
116	
117				err := Post(&WebhookRequestPayload{
118					URL:           server.URL,
119					ActivityType:  "memos.memo.created",
120					Creator:       "users/1",
121					SigningSecret: tc.secret,
122				})
123				require.NoError(t, err)
124	
125				require.True(t, strings.HasPrefix(gotID, "msg_"), "webhook-id should be prefixed with msg_")
126				require.NotEmpty(t, gotTimestamp)
127				require.True(t, strings.HasPrefix(gotSignature, "v1,"), "signature should carry the v1 version tag")
128	
129				// Recompute the signature the way a receiver would and confirm it matches.
130				mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, tc.key)
131				mac.Write([]byte(gotID + "." + gotTimestamp + "."))
132				mac.Write(gotBody)
133				want := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
134				require.Equal(t, "v1,"+want, gotSignature)
135			})
136		}
137	}

122			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
123		}
124		if currentUser.ID != userID && currentUser.Role != store.RoleAdmin {
125			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
126		}
127	
128		// Get existing webhooks
129		webhooks, err := s.Store.GetUserWebhooks(ctx, userID)
130		if err != nil {
131			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user webhooks: %v", err)
132		}

134		// Find the webhook to update
135		var targetWebhook *storepb.WebhooksUserSetting_Webhook
136		for _, webhook := range webhooks {
137			if webhook.Id == webhookID {
138				targetWebhook = webhook
139				break

141		}
142	
143		if targetWebhook == nil {
144			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "webhook not found")
145		}

147		// Update the webhook
148		updatedWebhook := &storepb.WebhooksUserSetting_Webhook{
149			Id:            webhookID,

164						updatedWebhook.Url = trimmed

166				case "display_name":

168				case "signing_secret":
169					secret := strings.TrimSpace(request.Webhook.SigningSecret)
170					if err := webhook.ValidateSigningSecret(secret); err != nil {
171						return nil, err

176				}
177			}
178		} else {
179			// If no update mask is provided, update all fields
180			if request.Webhook.Url != "" {

196			}
197		} else {
198			fmt.Printf("Server running on unix socket: %s\n", profile.UNIXSock)
199		}
200	
201		// Access mode is derived from instance_url: set = public, unset = private.
